exercise_group.instruction: [T] In Exercises 23–34, mark each statement True or False (T/F). Justify each answer.

problem.paragraph: (T/F) The equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is referred to as a vector equation.
(T/F) Every matrix equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ corresponds to a vector equation with the same solution set.
(T/F) If the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is inconsistent, then $$\mathbf{b}$$ is not in the set spanned by the columns of $$A$$ .
(T/F) A vector $$\mathbf{b}$$ is a linear combination of the columns of a matrix $$A$$ if and only if the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ has at least one solution.
(T/F) The equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is consistent if the augmented matrix $$\left\lbrack A,\mathbf{b} \right\rbrack$$ has a pivot position in every row.

(T/F) If $$A$$ is an $$m \times n$$ matrix whose columns do not span $$\mathbb{R}^{m}$$ , then the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is inconsistent for some $$\mathbf{b}$$ in $$\mathbb{R}^{m}$$ .
(T/F) The first entry in the product $$A\mathbf{x}$$ is a sum of products.
(T/F) Any linear combination vectors can always be written in the form $$A\mathbf{x}$$ for a suitable matrix $$A$$ and vector $$\mathbf{x}$$ .
(T/F) If the columns of an $$m \times n$$ matrix $$A$$ span $$\mathbb{R}^{m}$$ , then the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is consistent for each $$\mathbf{b}$$ in $$\mathbb{R}^{m}$$ .

(T/F) The solution set of a linear system whose augmented matrix is $$\lbrack\begin{array}{rrrr} \mathbf{a}_{1} & \mathbf{a}_{2} & \mathbf{a}_{3} & \mathbf{b} \end{array}\rbrack$$ is the same as the solution set of $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ , if $$A = \lbrack\begin{array}{rrr} \mathbf{a}_{1} & \mathbf{a}_{2} & \mathbf{a}_{3} \end{array}\rbrack$$ .

(T/F) If $$A$$ is an $$m \times n$$ matrix and if the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is inconsistent for some $$\mathbf{b}$$ in $$\mathbb{R}^{m}$$ , then $$A$$ cannot have a pivot position in every row.
(T/F) If the augmented matrix $$\lbrack\begin{array}{rr} A & \mathbf{b} \end{array}\rbrack$$ has a pivot position in every row, then the equation $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$$ is inconsistent.

What fact allows you to conclude that the system $$A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{w}$$ is consistent? (Note: $$\mathbf{x}_{1}$$ and $$\mathbf{x}_{2}$$ denote vectors, not scalar entries in vectors.)
